_comment: Box MCP server configuration. The agent reaches Box through this MCP server. Fill credentials via environment (do not hard-code secrets). This file is the config you register with your MCP-capable client / Bedrock agent gateway.
notes: Replace 'box-mcp-server' with the actual Box MCP server package/command you adopt.
autoApprove lists read-only tools that are safe to call without a prompt.
Write operations (upload report PDF, create review task) are intentionally omitted from autoApprove so they require confirmation.
